title: The Weekly Bus Pass
story: Farah paid for a single bus ride every school day. By Friday her purse was almost empty. Her father sat with her and listed the five fares on paper. Then he wrote the price of a weekly pass beside them. The pass cost less than the five rides together. Farah was surprised, because she had never compared the choices. She checked her jar of saved coins and found she had enough. On Monday she bought the pass at the station window. The clerk printed her name and the dates on it. Farah kept the pass in a hard pocket of her bag. Each morning she showed it to the driver instead of searching for coins. On Friday she still had money left for lunch. She recorded the saving in a notebook so she could see it. Next month she planned to buy the pass again on Sunday.
